scoreBasis: Related German-market ADAC test: 420 L normal rear compartment + 105 L separate underfloor storage = 525 L rear storage proxy. Front storage is excluded. This is an arithmetic utility proxy, not a VDA conversion of Tesla’s published capacity.
scope: Australian configuration rear cargo with the second row upright; all five seats available.
